components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink button that swaps to citrus on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 15px; background: #080808; color: #f0f0eb; font: 500 14px/1.15 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: background-color .5s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.1,1), color .5s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.1,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #ddec61; color: #080808; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #080808; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Board Card
components.description: White sheet on the desk with a serif title and subtle meta.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 144px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 20px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgb(71 71 65 / .05); color: #080808; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.1,1), box-shadow .3s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); } .ds-card-title { font: 400 24px/1.05 'Roboto Serif Variable', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-meta { font: 400 13px/1.3 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; color: #696967; }

narrative.overview: A warm grey desk with white sheets on it, a serif voice for names, Inter for controls, and citrus used like a highlighter. Borrowed from intentapp.dev by the owner's choice; follows the system theme.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals with one citrus accent
Tone and shadow instead of borders

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Citrus marks one thing per region.

rules.name: The No-Outline Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces never have a border.

dos: Do keep one citrus element per region
Do separate surfaces by tone and shadow
donts: Don't use mono outside keys, URLs and code
